about: VS-08's greybox views (Integrator): the composition Checkpoint A judges, after Gemini's VS-08 spatial brief. Retired cell by cell as each cell's own review file takes over. Views only: the core file owns the route and art_sentinels.

viewpoints.expectation: From the quay where the crossing lands you: the store anchoring the settlement up the slope, the harbor sheds at the water, and the tower above it all to the north-east; the whole island not given away at once.
From the store's porch looking up toward the Pointe: varied rooflines in front, the tower above and beyond them, larger than any building; partly hidden is fine.
Halfway up the trail: the ground rising, the path's surface changing underfoot, the tower ahead and above, an outcrop beside the trail that hides it a few steps on.
From the tower door looking back down over the island: the settlement small below, the quay and harbor, the headland far off; the climb was real.

From the north path where it crests the ridge's end (96 m out of the settlement, the first point on the trail with a line of sight to the hut, by a terrain trace): the cable hut and its mast below on the north shore, the open lake beyond; the hut was not visible from the settlement (only the mast's top, over the ridge).
On the trail west past the Pruitts' shed: the shed beside the path, the false-light post on the headland ahead across the bight; the sheltered harbor shore giving way to the exposed head.
Cresting the headland: the Ashland Grey's broken stern on its reef at the end of the causeway, looming; seen here, not from the settlement.
From the tower's gallery: the whole island at once (quay, settlement, headland, cable hut, the Grey's reef); plan §21 gallery_view's shape.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §5.5 (from the tower gallery, the whole island), §21

viewpoints.expectation: Along the south shore from the sheltered bight toward the west headland: cobble and driftwood on the sheltered shore, barer rock and talus toward the exposed head.
At the cable hut: the hut and the mast beside you, the dark tower above the rock to the south-east.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §5.5 (the tower pulls; visible from every exterior cell)

viewpoints.expectation: At the false-light post on the west head: the hide and the post here, the dark tower far across the harbor to the north-east.
On the Ashland Grey's stern deck: the hull underfoot, the causeway behind, the tower small and far but there.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §5.5 (the tower is never behind the player for long)

viewpoints.expectation: After the strike: the Ida moored along the quay wall at her berth (the same vessel as the crossing deck, moved by presence), her deck level with the quay across the fender.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §5.4 (two placements of the same art); Design/POIs/sombre.harbor.md

viewpoints.expectation: From the same quay spot as greybox_quay_arrival, turned west along the harbor: the false-light post small on the west head across the water, and the Ashland Grey's hull far beyond at the end of the reef. Both are far and quiet here; the headland crest is where the Grey looms (greybox_grey_reveal). With greybox_quay_arrival (the tower, NE) this is the plan's landmark overlap from the quay.
viewpoints.source: VerticalSlicePhasePlan.txt §5.5 (landmarks overlap: tower NE, post W, the Grey SW from the quay); C:/DeadCurrent_reviews/GEMINI_VS08_SPATIAL_BRIEF.md (the Grey as a delayed reveal)
